sources: Esri World Imagery around 38.7528,-93.5845 with the UseDirect site points

values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (April 15-October 31) basic $15, electric 30A $27, electric 50A $29, sewer/electric/water 50A $35, family basic $22, family electric 30A $42, family electric 50A $52; off-season (November 1-April 14) $14 / $23 / $25 / $29 / $20 / $36 / $46. Backcountry $10. Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads) takes one reservation fee.

fees.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/07/4BSP_Camping%20Fee%20Flyers_Knob%20Knoster_27.pdf (2027: 'Basic $15 $14', 'Electric - 30 AMP $27 $23', 'Electric - 50 AMP $29 $25', '*Sewer/Electric/Water 50 AMP $35 $29', family rows, 'Backcountry Camping $10 $10', 'Camping rates include sales tax') + CampingFees_KnobNoster_26.pdf (same figures), read 2026-11-07. Basic pads are 42-60 ft on the booking grid, so a 23-ft rig fits the basic base.

values.note: $2 a night off year-round for seniors 65+, persons with disabilities, military and veterans; ask at payment, with proof. Not for backcountry camping.

discounts.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/07/4BSP_Camping%20Fee%20Flyers_Knob%20Knoster_27.pdf ('A $2 PER NIGHT CAMPING DISCOUNT is available year-round for senior citizens (65 years and older), persons with disabilities, military and veterans'; '**Camping discount is not available for Backcountry Camping'), read 2026-11-07

hookups.source: https://msprdr.usedirect.com/MSPRDR/rdr/search/grid PlaceId 51, facility 787 (7 'Sewer/Electric/Water 50 amp' sites 01, 03-05, 07, 24, 25; 34 'Electric 50 amp'; 2 'Family Electric 50 amp'; 3 'Electric 30 amp') + https://mostateparks.com/park/knob-noster/camping ('basic, electric and sewer/electric/water campsites'), read 2026-11-07

values.note: 59 sites on the booking grid: 7 sewer/electric/water 50A, 34 electric 50A, 2 family electric 50A (F027, F031), 3 electric 30A, 13 basic. Pads 42-68 ft; every site fits 23 ft.

sites.source: https://msprdr.usedirect.com/MSPRDR/rdr/search/grid PlaceId 51, facility 787 (59 units, VehicleLength 42-68, AllowWebBooking true on all), read 2026-11-07

facilities.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/knob-noster/camping (campground amenity symbols: running water, restroom, shower, vault toilet, dump station, playground, amphitheater, wood lot, frost-free water; 'Potable water is available at a frost-free spigot in front of the visitor center' in the off-season) + the 2027 rate sheet ('showerhouse and modern restroom services are available to campers' in the on-season), read 2026-11-07

values.note: Online up to 12 months ahead or at 877-422-6766. Sites 1-25 are reservable year-round; sites 26-60 only April 15-October 31 (closed November 1-April 14). 'Reservable sites may be available on a walk-up registration basis if the site is not reserved.' No minimum stay on the grid. 15 days in any 30.

booking.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/knob-noster/camping ('reserve your Missouri State Parks campsite up to 12 months in advance'; campground table 'Reservations Year-round'; 'Sites 1 through 25 are open and reservable year-round. Sites 26 through 60 are reservable only from April 15 through Oct. 31 and are closed Nov. 1 through April 14.'; walk-up line; 15-in-30 rule) + UseDirect grid PlaceId 51 (AllowWebBooking true on all 59 units, MinStay 1), read 2026-11-07

note: Wooded campground on one long loop road; Lakes Buteo and Clearfork are nearby but not beside the sites. Sites 1-25 stay open all year; sites 26-60 close November 1-April 14. Generators are prohibited in the campground unless the park manager approves. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $14-15 basic base, electric +12, full hookup +20 (2026 and 2027 sheets identical); added 59 sites (pads 42-68 ft), 50A/water/sewer, facilities, military $2, 12-month window, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30, year-round reservations for sites 1-25. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin at site 01, ~305 m from the sites' centre.
flags: PIN: stored 38.7514,-93.5815 sits on site 01 at the east end of the loop, ~305 m from the centre of the 59 UseDirect site points. Move to 38.7528,-93.5845 (centre of the sites).

HOOKUPS: the park page says 'Sites 1-25 feature 50-amp electric service. Electric sites between sites 30-71 have 30-amp service', but the booking grid types sites 026-043 and 060 'Electric 50 amp' and only 051, 052 and 054 'Electric 30 amp'. The old note's '30A (seasonal)' was dropped; the grid is what books.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - the loop runs through forest; the nearest water to the pads is two small ponds (well under 5 acres, ~70-100 m from sites 022-026 and 013-015); Lakes Buteo and Clearfork are not beside the campground.
